t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They think there may be a pattern that switches, and the person before them said there was no pattern. And take advantage of the breaks.

vb_textbox.text: For the first bit it seemed like maybe picking specific colors was better, and that the "correct" color can change after a couple rounds. Later on I tried going by the color of the basket, I think sometimes the yellow basket is better and sometimes the red basket is better. Don't stress, its just a game:)
